title: choice (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. One question with set answers — a list, buttons, chips, a rating, times to pick, or several to tick — answered with one tap; plus suggested follow-ups the person can send as their own words.

question.description: The question, as the agent would ask it: “Which flight should I book for Tuesday?” Required for every style except suggestions.

style.description: How the options are drawn. buttons falls back to list with more than 3 options or a label over 24 characters; chips falls back to list over 24 characters.

select.description: one: a tap answers at once. many: checkboxes and a Send button (list and chips only).

rating.description: style: rating only. stars and scale take 5 options, thumbs 2, from low to high.

label.description: What the person picks. Buttons and chips ≤ 24 characters (longer labels make the client draw a list). Times: the full slot in words (“Sat, Oct 17, 11:30 AM”). Rating: the meaning of that point (“Very useful”). Suggestions: the exact message sent as the person’s own (≤ 80).

detail.description: One line under the label (list and multi): “Nonstop · $286 · lands in time for check-in”. Unknown is said in words (“price not known yet”).

recommended.description: The one suggested answer: a “Recommended” tag in a list, the ink chip or button. At most one; never preselected in select: one.

preselected.description: select: many only: ticked before the person changes anything. A plan to approve step by step preselects every step.

at.description: style: times only: the slot’s start. The client groups slots by day in the reader’s time zone, shows the time, and disables slots already past.

options.description: The answers, in the order to show them.

other.description: Adds a one-line Other field (list, chips). With select: one, typing in it shows Send.

decline_label.description: A way out under the options, as a text button: “None of these work”. Sends `answer` with `selected: []`.

note.description: One quiet line under the options: “Something else? Just reply in the chat.”

other.description: What the person wrote in Other.

answer.description: The answer as the agent received it, set in the update together with `resolution`, so every device draws the answered state.
